findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_chat_footer, create_plan_event, save_strategy · Private data: save_strategy, read_profile_change_history, read_profile_change_detail, restore_profile_change · Public sink: preview_goal_result_change, create_plan_event, create_note_event · Destructive: create_plan_event, delete_plan_events, delete_note_events, save_strategy, restore_profile_change.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_chat_footer, create_plan_event, save_strategy · Private data: save_strategy, read_profile_change_history, read_profile_change_detail, restore_profile_change · Public sink: preview_goal_result_change, create_plan_event, create_note_event · Destructive: create_plan_event, delete_plan_events, delete_note_events, save_strategy, restore_profile_change

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
